newsitem.title: USA: Staffmark buys St.Louis-based staffing firm.
newsitem.headline: Staffmark buys St.Louis-based staffing firm.

text.p: StaffMark Inc said it bought Technology Source, a privately held St. Louis-based staffing company with 1996 revenue of about $7 million, for an undisclosed amount.
The acquisition is expected to have a "positive impact" on StaffMark's 1997 earnings per share, StaffMark said. The company did not provide more specific details.
Officials from StaffMark were not immediately available to comment.
StaffMark Inc paid about $7 million to acquire Technology Source, StaffMark's Chief Financial Officer Terry Bellora told Reuters.
Of that amount, about 80 percent was cash and 20 percent was stock, he said.
He added that following the acquisition, which closed on Nov. 29, StaffMark had about $15 million of cash on hand.
Bellora said the acquisition would be accretive to StaffMark's annual earnings, although he did not specify by how much.
